classification.difficultyReason: Use the familiar two-intercept method to sketch six lines in standard form.

content.prompt: Sketch the graph of each equation by finding the $x$- and $y$-intercepts.

answer.worked:
When $y=0$:
$$\begin{align*}x+0&=4\\x&=4\end{align*}$$
When $x=0$:
$$\begin{align*}0+y&=4\\y&=4\end{align*}$$
Draw the straight line through $(4,0)$ and $(0,4)$.

spec.description: Unnumbered axes and a straight line through the two labelled intercepts; no grid.
